# Review accessibility and responsive behaviour

Exercise the finished theme as a reader, including any carousel or navigation changes. Address issues in the related implementation rather than treating a successful build as a visual or accessibility check.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Keyboard users can reach and operate navigation, colour controls and hero controls, with visible focus and sensible Escape/focus behaviour where applicable.
- [ ] Text and controls remain readable and usable at mobile and desktop widths, in light/dark modes and under reduced-motion settings.
- [ ] Core content and links remain usable when JavaScript is disabled; the zero-, one- and multi-hero cases do not trap or obscure content.
- [ ] Posts, pages, both tag views, 404, nested navigation and previous/next links are reviewed in the generated preview.
- [ ] Requested and content locales remain distinguishable, and links/assets work under a subpath base URL.
